title: Clairambault 460 — graphic cipher, pp53–55
contents: Spanish financial and military support for Bouillon: promised payments, eight armed frigates, and an advance toward Paris.

excerpt: un courrier à Mr de Condé? **Don Louis lui escrit et à Fonsaldagne pour les haster d'antr[er] en France et marcher droit à Paris.**
translation: a courier to Mr de Condé? **Don Louis writes to him and to Fonsaldagne to urge them to enter France and march straight to Paris.**
